name: Microwave Oats Idli
ingredients: ½ cup rolled oats, dry-ground to a powder
Tempering: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 6 curry leaves
steps: Microwave the oil, mustard seeds and curry leaves for 40 seconds, then mix into the oats, semolina, yogurt, carrot, paste and salt. Add water to a thick batter and rest 10 minutes.
Grease microwave-safe idli moulds or small cups.
Stir the fruit salt into the batter and spoon into the moulds.
Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes (for 4 idlis), until a skewer comes out clean.
note: Oats add soluble fibre; do not overmix after adding the fruit salt.
